subject: Marketplace SKU bundling, channel pass-through warranty & private offer terms
messages:
From: Aditi Rao <aditi@marketlytics.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.io, procurement@marketlytics.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace private offer — multi-cloud SKU mix and partner pass-through

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week. MarketLytics is ready to move from PoC to pilot for our data-enrichment pipeline, but we need to lock marketplace economics for the pilot (AWS + GCP) and confirm how the partner pass-through works for our VAR, CloudBridge.

Quick context:
- Expected pilot consumption (months 1–3): ~120k token-equivalent units per month (see attached estimate).
- CloudBridge will invoice MarketLytics for services, but they expect we can get a private offer on both clouds and guarantee a channel margin so they remain whole.

As a buyer, procurement asks for:
1) A single private-offer SKU that maps to your hosted usage (we can list both AWS and GCP line items)
2) A predictable discount cadence and an explicit channel pass-through calculation in the PO so CloudBridge can reconcile margins on their side
3) Evidence of invoice pathing / tax handling for reseller invoice flows (we need this for internal accounting)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Provide a private offer that includes a "channel warranty" line item (we'd like a mechanism that guarantees the reseller margin up to a capped uplift if list price moves during the pilot)
- Share the private-offer draft and the pass-through calculation you expect to use so our procurement can sign off

Attaching our estimated usage sheet. Looking to get this finalized by next Wed so we can start the pilot early April.

Thanks,
Aditi Rao
Head of Infrastructure — MarketLytics
Aditi Rao | MarketLytics
Attachment: MLTY-usage-estimate-20270315.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi@marketlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — multi-cloud SKU mix and partner pass-through

Aditi — thanks for the clear ask and for the estimate. Couple of quick confirmations and a proposed next step:

1) Channel warranty concept: yes — we can offer a capped channel-warranty credit line that triggers if list-price adjustments or marketplace fee changes reduce the reseller net below an agreed floor. We usually structure it as:
   - Floor net % to reseller (e.g., 15% of seat/usage net)
   - Warranty cap (absolute $ amount over pilot)
   - Trigger window (e.g., 30 days after a pricing event)

2) Private-offer SKU bundling: we can map a single private-offer to your hosted usage and itemize AWS/GCP marketplace SKUs behind the scenes (the buyer sees one PO but the marketplace backend maps to two SKUs). That supports consolidated billing and a single deal id for your accounting.

3) Invoice pathing and tax: Vanessa — can you add the standard reseller invoice pathing note and a sample invoice header we can include in the PO?

Next step: I attached a short private-offer draft (RDW-private-offer-draft-v1.pdf) and a channel-waterfall-proposal template (CSV) for Ben to fill in with proposed % splits and the warranty cap. Ben — can you do a first-pass channel split and a waterfall that shows how the warranty credit would be computed, and include a sample fallback if list-prices change mid-pilot?

Target: get a mutually agreed draft to Aditi and MarketLytics procurement by EOD Wed (3/17). If that's tight, confirm an alternate milestone.

Best,
David Kim
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | david_kim@redwood.com
Attachments: RDW-private-offer-draft-v1.pdf (proposal), channel-waterfall-proposal.csv (template)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditi Rao <aditi@marketlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — multi-cloud SKU mix and partner pass-through

David / team,

First-pass attached. Key highlights and open Qs below. I modeled the waterfall in the CSV using the pilot numbers Aditi supplied.

Summary of proposed mechanics:
- Base private-offer discount: 28% off list across the consolidated SKU (this folds billing across AWS/GCP marketplaces into one buyer-facing PO).
- Channel pass-through: 75% of the discount uplift is paid through to CloudBridge (so partner net = list*(1 - base discount) + partner uplift). Example included in CSV.
- Channel warranty: capped credit of $18,000 for the 3-month pilot. The warranty triggers only if a marketplace fee or list-price change causes the partner realized margin to drop below 12% on any monthly reconciliation.
- Fallback: if a marketplace delists a SKU, Redwood will route the affected consumption to the closest matching SKU and apply a one-time reconciliation credit (no more than 5% of monthly spend).

Open questions I flagged in the CSV:
- Preferred partner invoicing model: CloudBridge invoices MarketLytics (preferred), or Redwood invoices MarketLytics and passes funds to CloudBridge? That changes tax handling.
- Do you want the warranty to be quarterly-adjusted vs. month-by-month triggers? Month-by-month is more predictable for the partner but operationally heavier for us.

Attachment: channel-waterfall-proposal.csv (CSV)

If this looks reasonable I can convert the numbers into the private-offer legal language for RDW-private-offer-draft-v2.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Channel Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi@marketlytics.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — multi-cloud SKU mix and partner pass-through

Hi Aditi — jumping in on invoice & tax pathing.

Short answers:
- Invoice route: CloudBridge can invoice MarketLytics directly. Redwood will provide a purchase confirmation and a statement of routing for marketplace reconciliation so CloudBridge has documentation to substantiate the reseller margin.
- Tax: we will include an invoice header template showing Redwood as the technical seller for marketplace listing purposes, with CloudBridge listed as the reseller on the reconciliation schedule. For your procurement/compliance team, I have a sample header below that you can paste into the PO.

Sample invoice header (to include in PO):
"Redwood Inference (technical seller) — marketplace listing ID: RDW-MKT-2027
CloudBridge (reseller) — partner id: CB-9231
Buyer: MarketLytics — billing address and tax id as provided on PO.
Net allocation: as per channel-waterfall-proposal.csv — warranty credit computed at reconciliation."

Ben — the channel waterfall looks good. I recommend the monthly trigger for the pilot (gives CloudBridge quicker visibility). If MarketLytics is comfortable with the $18k cap, we should convert to draft v2 and link the warranty clause to the reconciliation appendix (keeps legal language tight).

Aditi — attaching a one-page sample invoice header and an ops checklist you can share with CloudBridge. If procurement wants a call to walk through the waterfall and tax pathing I'd be happy to join.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Deal Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: RDW-invoice-header-sample.pdf (pdf)
